9ad2c3a383552ac3.description: About the Role Smart Food Company for Catering Services is seeking a Storekeeper to join its F&B operations. This full-time position is available in both Jeddah and Riyadh, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Storekeeper will be responsible for managing food materials and packaging, ensuring accurate inventory, and maintaining high standards of food safety and stock rotation. Key Responsibilities Receive and inspect incoming deliveries, verifying them against purchase orders and delivery notes. Organize and label stock in designated dry, chilled, and frozen storage areas, ensuring correct storage conditions are maintained for each. Maintain accurate stock records using the inventory/ERP system and supporting documents such as Goods Received Notes (GRNs), requisitions, and issue notes. Apply FIFO (First-In, First-Out) / FEFO (First-Expiry, First-Out) principles, monitor expiry dates, and take action on slow-moving or near-expiry items to minimize waste. Issue materials to the kitchen and production teams against approved requisitions. Conduct periodic physical stock counts, investigate variances, and report discrepancies to the Cost Control team. Monitor stock levels and raise low-stock and reorder alerts to the Procurement team. Ensure all storage areas are kept clean, organized, and compliant with hygiene and HACCP requirements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of experience in a similar role, preferably within the food and beverage industry or catering services. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in either Jeddah or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within F&B operations, ensuring adherence to food safety standards in storage and inventory management. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

9ad47e999c297aac.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن حاجتها لمدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق كافة الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل نجاح المشروع بشكل دوري، ورفعها إلى الأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمبادئ وعمليات إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الميزانيات والإجراءات التعاقدية للمشاريع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على التنسيق الفعال مع فرق العمل والأطراف المعنية. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات وإدارة المخاطر. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير الدورية للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات في مدينة تبوك. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام الإشراف والمتابعة لضمان نجاح المشاريع. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات.

Monitor customers regarding proper pricing and payment to reduce days sales outstanding and achieve targeted gross margins. 9a6f2edcc8f2fa6e.description: نبحث عن مصممة جرافيك مبدعة للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير حساباتنا على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي وتعزيز الهوية البصرية لعلامتنا التجارية. ستكون مسؤولة عن ابتكار تصاميم احترافية وجذابة، وتصوير المنتجات وإبرازها بطريقة تسويقية مميزة، بالإضافة إلى إدارة المحتوى البصري ونشر صور المنتجات بشكل يومي على حساباتنا في منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. المهامإنشاء محتوى بصري مبتكر لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والمواقع الإلكترونية. تصوير المنتجات باحترافية وإبراز تفاصيلها بشكل جذاب. تعديل ومعالجة صور المنتجات باستخدام برامج التصميم لضمان جودة الصور. نشر صور المنتجات بشكل يومي على حساباتنا في منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. إعداد وتنظيم جدول يومي لتصوير المنتجات وتصميم المحتوى ونشره. تصميم إعلانات المنتجات والعروض والحملات الموسمية. تصميم أغلفة المنتجات والملصقات والمطبوعات التجارية. المساهمة في تطوير حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وتحسين جودة المحتوى البصري. التعاون مع فريق التسويق وصناعة المحتوى لتنفيذ أفكار إبداعية. تحويل الأفكار إلى تصاميم احترافية ومميزة تتناسب مع هوية العلامة التجارية.

9a3562ce26845b3f.description: About the Role Valvoline Global Operations is seeking a Senior Recruiting Specialist for the MEA region. Develop and execute tailored sourcing strategies based on MEA market dynamics, cultural nuances, and talent availability. Manage diverse candidate pipelines across multiple countries simultaneously. 9a281b74baaad8fc.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is dedicated to supporting the Saudi armed forces by providing essential platforms and services. The company is committed to Saudi Arabia's National Objectives, investing significantly in the development of Saudi talent, technology, infrastructure, and local defense supply chain companies. These investments contribute to the growth of the Saudi defense industry and foster a skilled, productive workforce. The Role: Munitions Maintenance Technician 1 This full-time position is for a Munitions Maintenance Technician 1, an experienced professional classified at Grade 8. The role is based in Riyadh and is open exclusively to Saudi Nationals. The technician will be responsible for the maintenance, inspection, testing, and repair of RSAF munitions, ensuring operational readiness and safety. Key Responsibilities Perform all required maintenance, inspection, testing, and repair on current RSAF Munitions. Ensure thorough adherence to Munitions Safety Procedures. Develop and conduct On-the-Job Training (OJT) for Saudi National and RSAF Trainees, including classroom training as needed. Maintain munitions tools, equipment, Aerospace Ground Equipment (AGE), and special-to-type servicing stands, ensuring compliance with tool control in maintenance sections. Prepare, inspect, and store all RSAF inventory munitions in accordance with RSAF Procedures. Provide timely and accurate delivery of munitions to RSAF Aircraft Squadrons. Monitor and manage all supply issues impacting the Munitions Maintenance sections. Qualifications and Experience Must be a munitions graduate from a military or civilian school (*, RSAF 26170 / 26370 / 18170) or possess an equivalent qualification. A minimum of 5 years of practical experience working with the full range of RSAF Munitions Systems in either a military or civilian setting is required. Proficiency in English Language comprehension, both written and oral, with a minimum of 75% RSAF equivalent ECL. Must be a quality-minded, mature individual with a positive and proactive approach to all aspects of the munitions field. Possession of a current driving license is mandatory. Required Knowledge and Skills Full conversance with the principles of Munitions Maintenance, Inspection, Assembly, and Disassembly. Thorough understanding of Explosives Safety, Handling, Transportation, and Storage principles. Sound knowledge of the RSAF OJT program for Munitions Maintenance. Familiarity with the principles and requirements detailed within RSAF I’s 7606-4 & 7601-4, as well as the RSAF Publications System in general. Competency in using the standard RSAF Software suite, including Microsoft Office.

9a47f4aae4eca4a0.description: About the Role Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is seeking an Information Security Manager to lead and manage all activities related to protecting the company's digital and physical information assets. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah city, and operates within the Information Security division. The manager will be responsible for implementing and maintaining data security policies and procedures, ensuring data remains secure and compliant with regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the implementation of JCDC's data security strategy and the development and enforcement of data security procedures. Respond to and manage data security incidents, including post-incident analysis and preventive measure implementation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to protect data assets and integrate data security best practices across the organization. Execute training and awareness programs on data security practices and classified information protection. Oversee the selection and implementation of data security tools and technologies, and monitor industry trends and threats. Manage reviews of access controls and permissions, and the process for granting, modifying, and revoking access to data resources. Approve identity and access management requests for various systems (database, SAP, cloud drives, DLP, RMS) to prevent data breaches. Monitor user access review activities across JCD data systems. Develop and implement processes for handling data subject requests (access, rectification, deletion). Ensure data privacy best practices are integrated throughout the organization and monitor compliance with data privacy laws. Lead Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for projects and systems. Manage the organization's data breach response and notification procedures. Strategic and Operational Management Ensure the divisional strategy is cascaded into sectional business plans for vertical alignment and horizontal integration. Manage the achievement of objectives by leading the designated section, setting individual goals, managing performance, and motivating staff. Lead talent development initiatives for the section, collaborating with experts to ensure talent availability. Prepare and recommend the sectional budget, monitoring financial performance against it. Ensure effective implementation of policies, procedures, and controls to meet requirements and deliver cost-effective service. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and sustainability of systems, processes, and practices. Ensure timely and accurate preparation of department reports that meet JCDC requirements and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in information security management. Demonstrated ability to manage and lead teams in information security activities. Experience in developing and enforcing data security policies and procedures. Proficiency in managing data security incidents and implementing preventive measures. Familiarity with identity and access management principles and practices. Knowledge of data privacy regulations and experience in conducting privacy impact assessments. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Information Security division at Jeddah Central Development Company. The role requires coordination with various teams across the organization and is based in the Makkah region, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah city.

9a046be7ab9aad79.description: About the Role Alert International is seeking a Marketing Executive to support day-to-day marketing and communications activities for assigned facilities in Dhahran and Al Khobar. While the primary focus will be on assigned facilities, the role also contributes to the wider KSA and Group Marketing & Communications strategy, with occasional support for other locations and broader marketing initiatives as required. Key Duties and Responsibilities Support the daily marketing and communications requirements for the Dhahran and Al Khobar facilities. Collaborate with Patient Experience, clinical teams, and other facility stakeholders to identify upcoming activities and marketing needs. Support marketing activities for individual services, clinics, programs, and facility initiatives. Assist in developing smaller service-line marketing plans and campaign ideas, seeking direction from the KSA Marketing & Communications Manager. Coordinate local marketing requirements and ensure follow-through on agreed activities. Manage the development of marketing materials for events and on-site needs, including briefing the design team, reviewing requirements, and overseeing production and delivery. 9a4261ba49d3c04a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أوبا ستايل في الرياض عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها بدوام كامل. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة استلام وتخزين وصرف المواد والسلع داخل المستودع، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات الجرد. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين الذين يسعون لبناء مسيرتهم المهنية في إدارة المستودعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الموردة، ووضعها في الأماكن المخصصة لها، وتثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف، وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب، وحفظ جميع معاملات الإدخالات والإخراجات المتعلقة بالمستودع. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال أمناء المخازن أو إدارة المستودعات. القدرة على استلام وفحص المواد بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتخزين البضائع. القدرة على التعامل مع سندات الصرف وحفظ السجلات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المستودع لإدارة العمليات اليومية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة أوبا ستايل.

9a55bfb4543c342f.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Radiation Therapist. This full-time position involves preparing radiation therapy treatment plans and delivering radiation treatment to patients as prescribed by the Radiation Oncologist. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Assist with treatment planning, including the use of simulators, Computer Technology (CT) Sim, dose calculations, obtaining contours, and making templates. Support the Senior Mould Room Technologist in creating shells and radiation protective devices. Prepare the treatment room and administer prescribed radiation treatments, ensuring accurate documentation on treatment sheets. Verify treatment prescriptions, diagnoses, calculations, and patient identification. Conduct routine safety checks and ensure the proper operation of equipment. Report any equipment malfunctions or potential safety hazards to senior staff. Maintain patient records, reports, and treatment files, and explain radiation procedures to patients. Collect CPT and statistics in a timely manner. Liaise with all sections of the department to ensure the smooth operation of the assigned area. Inform treating Radiation Oncologists of any undue patient conditions or reactions. Participate in self and others' education, training, and development. Adhere to all Hospital policies and procedures. Perform other related duties as assigned. Experience and Professional Development Candidates should be experienced rotational radiation therapists. The role emphasizes continuous professional growth and development through ongoing education to enhance skills and knowledge in the field. Work Environment This position is based at King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Radiation Therapist will work within a dedicated department, collaborating with various sections to ensure efficient patient care and treatment delivery.

This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing the complete procurement lifecycle from strategy development to supplier management. 9ab9473a19e52df0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مخزن الأدوية العربي السعودي عن مراقب مخزون للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0-1 سنة، حيث سيركز على إدارة وتنظيم المخزون لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة ودقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد سجلات وبطاقات الصنف لجميع عناصر السلع والمواد المخزونة. إدخال البيانات المتعلقة بالمواد والسلع المستلمة والمصروفة (المدخلات والمخرجات) بدقة. المشاركة في تحديد حد الطلب للمواد والسلع، وإشعار الأطراف المعنية لتجهيز طلبيات الشراء. متابعة ومراقبة تاريخ انتهاء صلاحية المنتجات المخزونة لضمان جودتها. المشاركة في عمليات جرد المخزون ومطابقة الكميات الفعلية مع السجلات والبطاقات. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة المخزون أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد السجلات والبطاقات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في إدخال البيانات والتعامل مع أنظمة إدارة المخزون. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المخزون في مخزن الأدوية العربي السعودي. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل مخزن الأدوية العربي السعودي، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

9a4d7fc08b0b274a.description: About Worley Worley is a global company specializing in energy, chemicals, and resources, headquartered in Australia. The company partners with customers to deliver projects and create value across the lifecycle of their assets. Worley provides consulting, engineering, procurement, and construction services, extending through operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, Worley supports customers in navigating complexity to meet current needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. The Role of Lead Materials / Corrosion Engineer Worley is seeking a Lead Materials / Corrosion Engineer to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time position is responsible for consultancy and engineering activities related to corrosion management and materials integrity within various projects. Key Responsibilities Participate under Principal / Lead Engineer supervision to create and develop Corrosion Management Programs. Specify and identify corrosion loops and potential corrosion mechanisms. Create and develop corrosion control strategies covering various corrosion mitigation methodologies. Apply RBI assessment methodology. Prepare and issue engineering corrosion philosophies, material selection reports, and perform corrosion rate calculations. Create and develop material selection diagrams. Advise on equipment, valves, and piping material selection based on internal and external corrosion considerations. Provide authoritative technical assessment and interpretation of corrosion aspects. Support cost-effective material selection for Company engineering projects during the design phase. Prepare coating specifications and insulation specifications. Ensure all produced deliverables comply with the Company's QA/QC and ISO System requirements. Carry out, review, approve, and/or supervise work using Company and Client design methods, standards, and data, ensuring high quality and adherence to Project requirements. Ensure compliance with Company and Client’s Health and Safety, Environmental, and Quality Management Procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, contributing to Worley's global projects and customer partnerships.

9ad9e335b5c2abd9.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking an Operating Room Nurse 3 to join their team in Al-Ahsa or Al Qatif. This full-time position involves providing complex and direct quality nursing care to patients within the Operating Room (OR) setting, guided by established organizational and departmental policies and procedures. The role requires 5-10 years of experience and may involve working various shifts, including on-call and scheduled overtime, to meet operational needs. Key Responsibilities Deliver high-quality nursing care services, with a focus on complex cases. Assist in managing workflow, ensuring proper resource utilization, and providing mentorship to junior nurses. Ensure adherence to clinical protocols and participate in the evaluation of patient outcomes. Achieve and/or maintain the mandated set of activities for level 3, requiring a minimum total of 20 points in at least four categories within each 12-month cycle, as outlined in the Clinical Advancement Program. Utilize the nursing process to assess, plan, implement, evaluate, and document patient care from admission through discharge, specific to the patient's age. Provide nursing care and patient/family education consistent with the plan of care and patient needs, respecting privacy, dignity, personal preference, and culture. Precept new hires and trainees during their probation training period, participating in recommendations regarding progress and training needs. Respond promptly and effectively to emergency and lifesaving situations using clinical skills, critical thinking, and evidence-based practices. Perform a wide range of nursing procedures with attention to accuracy, patient safety, and comfort, while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized environment. Represent the unit or department on committees, special interest groups, and task forces as assigned by the OR manager. Complete specific competencies identified by the manager/clinical nurse educator according to the scope of service of the assigned area, or adhere to unit-specific activities for 2H OR, 2H PACU, or Main OR. Operating Room Specific Competencies Ensure safe procedures according to international patient safety goals and JHAH policies. Act as a scrub or circulating nurse based on the OR schedule. Set up the operating room according to the type of operation and Association of Perioperative Registered Nurses (AORN) recommendations. Assist the surgeon during complex operative, diagnostic, and therapeutic procedures within the scope of service. Ensure all pre-, intra-, and post-op documentation is completed in the relevant format and in a timely manner. Demonstrate familiarity with specialized OR equipment and handle equipment malfunction during surgery. Evaluate supplies and equipment for patient care, providing input to the service team leader or OR Manager. Observe and maintain strict aseptic practices. Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) Specific Competencies (if applicable) Monitor patients in the PACU utilizing American Society of Perianesthesia Nurses (ASPAN) and JHAH standards and policies. Ensure all postanesthesia documentation is completed promptly and in the relevant format. Administer medications intravenously or by patient-controlled analgesia as per clinician's order, adhering to JHAH standards and policies. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience as a Registered Nurse, with a focus on operating room environments. The role requires a commitment to professional practice and continuous improvement in nursing care. Work Environment This full-time position is based in the Operating Room of Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare facilities in Al-Ahsa or Al Qatif. The work schedule is assigned to meet operational needs and may include on-call duties and scheduled overtime.

9a3c0fa9adb6a06b.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim is seeking a Credit Control Executive to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for managing credit deals and monitoring accounts receivables across various brand portfolios, contributing to the financial health and operational efficiency of Famco KSA. Key Responsibilities Manage credit deals and monitor accounts receivables across brand portfolios. Conduct detailed credit assessments and maintain customer credit master data in SAP. Ensure compliance with credit approval protocols and update terms in SAP. Proactively monitor payment irregularities and collaborate with finance and sales teams to resolve collection issues. Conduct periodic reviews of credit limits and payment terms. Engage directly with clients as needed for credit and collection matters. Ensure credit approval is completed as per DOA and within SLA timeframes. Update credit approval terms in SAP Customer Credit master. Maintain the credit approval tracker. Accounts Receivable Monitoring Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities. Follow up with Business Finance and Sales teams for resolution of issues. Ensure timely accounting of payments received from customers. Monitor unallocated credits and coordinate necessary adjustments with FSSC O2C/Business Finance. Develop AR reports and communicate collection issues to senior management. Credit Review and Reporting Conduct periodic credit reviews of accounts. Coordinate with the Head of Corporate Credit and Business Heads to maintain adequate credit limits. Revise payment terms as necessary and conduct field visits to clients when required. Prepare monthly reports within three working days post month-close. Timely report delinquent accounts status and ensure 95% of credit assessments are completed within approved SLA. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in credit control or a related financial role. Demonstrated experience in underwriting and credit application processes. Proficiency in SAP, particularly with customer credit master data. Strong analytical skills for credit assessment and accounts receivable monitoring. Ability to collaborate effectively with finance and sales teams.

Background in leading multi-phase, multi-package programs from planning through handover. 9a4e2e0670d07414.description: About the Role Alesayi Beverages is seeking an Accounting Manager to oversee the company's accounting operations in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports within established deadlines. Oversee tax compliance activities, including VAT, withholding tax, ZATCA requirements, and other statutory filings, ensuring timely and accurate submissions. Coordinate the preparation of schedules and supporting documents for internal and external audits and facilitate audit requirements. Review accounting records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and proper documentation of financial transactions. Support the Finance Manager in preparing financial analyses, management reports, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making. Lead, coach, and develop the accounting team to enhance performance, technical competency, and compliance with company standards. Experience in coordinating internal and external audits. Leadership skills to manage and develop an accounting team. Familiarity with ERP and financial systems for efficiency improvements. 9a8e80cb551f616a.description: About the Role AlJammaz Technologies is seeking an experienced Collections Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 9aad908feadeae30.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة بفعالية وأمان، مع الالتزام التام بالمسارات والخطط المحددة وقواعد السلامة المرورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقاً لمسارات العمل المحددة وخطط التشغيل المعتمدة. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والسلامة والأمن، والتأكد من عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على الشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها وكفاءتها التشغيلية. معالجة المشكلات والأعطال البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على الشاحنة بشكل فوري. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء المختصين عند ملاحظة أي أعطال أو خلل يتطلب تدخلاً متخصصاً. الالتزام التام بجميع أدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو مجال ذي صلة. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع المركبة. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. متطلبات العمل الالتزام التام بمواعيد العمل والمسارات المحددة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل بمسؤولية فردية وضمن فريق. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بمعايير السلامة والجودة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

9a66e1e47f9fbf66.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عطيه حنش الزهرانى عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتنفيذ وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. ستكون جزءًا من فريق يعمل بدوام كامل لضمان جودة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المتعلقة بالتمديدات الكهربائية، بدءًا من التخطيط وحتى الصيانة، مع التركيز على الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية للمشاريع المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية، وفهم مكوناتها بدقة. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة سير أعمال تنفيذ التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص الأعطال في التمديدات الكهربائية، وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحًا يمتلك أساسًا جيدًا في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية، مع القدرة على التعلم والتطبيق العملي. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمديدات الكهربائية ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، حيث يتطلب الدور التواجد الميداني والعمل ضمن فريق متكامل لضمان إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتيح فرصة للانخراط بشكل كامل في مهام ومشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

9a8372dec2aac08e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بخيت بن عبدالوهاب بن بخيت الزهراني للمقاولات عن كاتب اتصال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تنسيق ومتابعة الاتصالات والمراسلات بين إدارة المشروع والجهات ذات العلاقة، لضمان سرعة التواصل ودعم سير أعمال المشروع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنسيق الاتصالات والمراسلات بين المشروع والبلدية والجهات ذات العلاقة. استلام وتسليم الخطابات والمعاملات الرسمية ومتابعتها. متابعة طلبات وملاحظات الجهة المالكة وإبلاغ فريق المشروع بها. التنسيق مع مدير المشروع والمهندسين بشأن المستندات والمتطلبات. تنظيم وأرشفة المراسلات والمعاملات والمستندات. متابعة المواعيد والاجتماعات والتنسيق مع الجهات ذات العلاقة. إعداد تقارير مختصرة عن حالة المراسلات والمعاملات القائمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنسيق ومتابعة الاتصالات والمراسلات بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة في أرشفة المستندات والمعاملات. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في مدينة الباحة. القدرة على التواصل بوضوح وفعالية مع مختلف الأطراف. بيئة العمل سيعمل كاتب الاتصال ضمن فريق المشروع في الباحة، وسيكون مسؤولاً عن دعم سير العمليات من خلال ضمان سلاسة تدفق المعلومات والمستندات بين الإدارة والجهات الخارجية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة بخيت بن عبدالوهاب بن بخيت الزهراني للمقاولات.

9a5cd06118a66216.description: نبحث عن مساعد موارد بشرية متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في دعم العمليات اليومية للإدارة. ستكون مسؤولاً عن المساعدة في مهام التوظيف، وإدارة بيانات الموظفين، وتقديم الدعم الإداري العام. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة، وقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق، ورغبة في النمو في مجال الموارد البشرية، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * المساعدة في عملية التوظيف، بما في ذلك نشر الوظائف، وفرز السير الذاتية، وجدولة المقابلات. * إدخال وتحديث بيانات الموظفين في أنظمة الموارد البشرية. * تقديم الدعم في إعداد المستندات والتقارير المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية. * المساعدة في تنظيم الفعاليات والأنشطة الخاصة بالموظفين. * التعامل مع استفسارات الموظفين المتعلقة بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة.

9a17d7547d57112a.description: Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We were set up for problems that do not fit the large-firm model, and we take on a limited number of mandates at a time. The principals who scope the work are the ones who deliver it. About the role This is a permanent, full-time role for someone at the start of a career in advisory, working from our Riyadh office on a hybrid arrangement. You would support the principals across live mandates, which means sitting in the room where the work is scoped and seeing how a view gets formed and defended. You carry real pieces of each engagement from the first week: the research behind a market question, the model that tests a client's assumptions, the note that records what was agreed. We are looking for someone who wants to learn the trade by doing it rather than by watching it. What you will do Build the evidence base for a mandate: market data, competitor positions, and the economics of a client's portfolio, pulled together into something a principal can read in ten minutes. Draft and maintain working documents (issue notes, interview guides, board papers) and keep versions straight as a mandate moves forward. Sit in on client interviews and workshops, take the notes that matter, and turn them into a short written summary the same day. Prepare the numbers behind a recommendation, including simple models and sensitivity checks, and be able to explain where each figure came from. Keep the engagement's own administration in order: action lists, follow-ups with client teams, and the record of what has been decided and by whom. What we need from you A bachelor's degree, and a genuine interest in how organizations make decisions about strategy, capital and structure. Clear writing in English. Arabic is a strong advantage for client interviews and for reading local material in the original. Comfort with spreadsheets and slides, and the patience to check your own numbers before someone else does. Enough structure to juggle two or three workstreams without losing one, and the habit of flagging a problem early rather than late. Discretion. Much of what you will see and hear inside a client's organization does not travel. What success looks like In the first six to twelve months, you would become the person a principal trusts with the groundwork on a mandate: the research is done properly, the numbers hold up, and the note is written before it is asked for. A good first year means you have contributed to real client decisions, not prepared material that sat unused. It also means you can explain the logic of a piece of analysis to a client team without reaching for the slides. Clients should come to recognize your name as someone whose work they can rely on. How we work Principals scope every mandate and stay with it through delivery, so the person who defines the question is the person you will work with on the answer. Staffing is decided by the principal running the engagement, and sign-off sits with them too. You would be expected to form a view and say it, including when it disagrees with a draft on the table. Escalation is short: if something is unclear or going wrong, you raise it with the principal leading the work directly. As you build judgment, more of the client contact comes your way. What the role offers This is a permanent, full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on a hybrid arrangement. You would see mandates from the inside across corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, and organization and talent, working alongside principals rather than at a distance from them. The exposure is broad because the firm is deliberately narrow in what it takes on. You will learn how boards and committees reach decisions, and how a recommendation is tested once it meets management. Who tends to do well here The people who settle in quickly tend to be writers first and presenters second: they would rather get the argument right on the page than perform it in a room. They are comfortable working in a client's own vocabulary and asking the simple question everyone else has skipped. They like being accountable for a number and will chase down the reason it moved. Most of all, they are curious about why an institution behaves the way it does, and patient enough to find out.

9a61873cf323e576.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الكلية وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها بهدف تقليل العادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفقدية لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات لضمان اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الشأن. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. فهم عميق لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتطبيقاتها في المشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل العمليات وتقديم حلول لتحسين الأداء البيئي والسلامة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. المعرفة بأحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير السلامة والجودة البيئية في جميع عمليات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

9ab653bc97500668.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco | أرامكو السعودية is seeking a Senior Data Governance & Architecture Specialist to join its Corporate Data Office. This full-time role focuses on strengthening corporate-wide data governance capabilities and enabling trusted, well-architected, high-quality data across the organization. The Corporate Data Office is responsible for establishing and executing world-class data governance to ensure data assets are proactively and efficiently managed, fostering a data-driven organization in line with strategic goals and national/international data regulations. Role Responsibilities The primary responsibility of this role is to translate governance policies and standards into practical operating processes, data architecture deliverables, measurable data quality controls, and effective use of corporate data governance platforms. This position involves collaboration with business data owners, data stewards, technology teams, and other stakeholders to enhance accountability, discoverability, consistency, and reliability of critical data assets. Key Accountabilities Implement and continuously improve corporate data governance policies, standards, procedures, and stewardship practices. Define and maintain data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, critical data elements, business glossaries, and governance workflows. Support governance forums, issue escalation, compliance assessments, adoption metrics, and remediation tracking. Develop and maintain conceptual and logical data models, data definitions, domain mappings, and architecture standards in collaboration with solution architects. Document data flows, system-of-record relationships, data integration patterns, and end-to-end lineage for priority data domains. Review solution designs for alignment with data standards, interoperability, reuse, and governance requirements. Establish data quality dimensions, business rules, profiling methods, thresholds, and monitoring controls for critical data. Coordinate data quality assessments, root-cause analysis, remediation plans, and issue management with business and technical owners. Define scorecards, KPIs, and reporting to measure and communicate improvements in data quality. Support selection, configuration, deployment, integration, and ongoing enhancement of corporate data governance platforms. Configure and administer metadata catalogs, business glossaries, lineage, stewardship workflows, data quality capabilities, and role-based access. Drive platform onboarding, metadata ingestion, user acceptance testing, training, adoption, and operational support in partnership with IT and vendors. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong stakeholder engagement, analytical problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional delivery skills. Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles. Familiarity with applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. Work Location The work location will be within Saudi Arabia, with the specific city to be detailed in the job offer.

9a03aaa630b30b1d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة الواكد للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيساهم المهندس الميكانيكي في تصميم وتطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية. تحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة للمشاريع الصناعية. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة بأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد (HVAC) والمعدات الميكانيكية ذات الصلة. مهارات في إعداد برامج الصيانة والتشغيل. بيئة العمل تُعد هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة الواكد للمقاولات. ستوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للمهندس الميكانيكي تطبيق خبراته وتطوير مهاراته في مشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

9a0721d7f1559c57.description: About the Role Adobe is seeking a Principal Programme Manager, Professional Services, to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is one of the most senior programme delivery positions within Adobe Professional Services, focusing on leading the company's largest, most strategic, and complex customer programmes in the Middle East. The successful candidate will serve as the single point of accountability for all Adobe deliverables across these programmes. Programme Leadership and Integration This role involves co-leading complex programmes with customer leadership, integrating multiple Adobe service constructs, workstreams, partners, and customer teams through a unified operating model. The Principal Programme Manager will establish the necessary governance, commercial discipline, and delivery rhythm to ensure programmes remain healthy, predictable, and focused on measurable customer value. This includes orchestrating Adobe's cross-functional organization, bringing together Customer Experience (CX) and Creative & Production teams into one integrated Adobe programme. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end programme leadership as the single point of accountability for Adobe delivery across complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes, co-leading with the customer's programme lead. Mobilise programmes efficiently, establishing the operating model, core team, integrated roadmap, quarterly plan, shared value-scored backlog, RAID and decision log, capacity plan, governance forums, and systems of record. Lead the Adobe Core Team, project managers, and workstream leads, integrating delivery, architecture, Customer Success, transformation, change, and value. Integrate Adobe's Customer Experience and Creative & Production teams into a single programme, orchestrating capabilities such as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Firefly, and Firefly Foundry. Chair the Adobe programme leadership rhythm and co-chair customer governance, including Joint Programme Boards, quarterly planning, executive steering committees, and business reviews. Maintain programme health by actively managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, resourcing, dependencies, assumptions, risks, issues, and customer readiness. Drive predictable services revenue and programme financial health through accurate forecasts, resource alignment, cost awareness, invoicing inputs, and commercial change control. Manage contractual and financial milestones through timely customer acceptance and approval, ensuring clear evidence and acceptance criteria. Connect delivery to customer outcomes, KPIs, adoption, and value realisation, ensuring successful transition of capabilities into business as usual. Maintain trusted executive relationships and provide concise, transparent reporting on programme health, value, finances, decisions, escalations, and required leadership action. Support pre-sales and deal shaping by validating the delivery model, roles, governance, estimates, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance approach, risks, and mobilisation plan. Coach project and programme managers across UKI and the Middle East, contribute reusable programme practices, and enhance complex programme leadership standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in programme management. Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes. Experience in establishing and maintaining programme governance, commercial discipline, and delivery rhythms. Proficiency in integrating cross-functional teams and capabilities, including customer experience and creative production technologies. Strong financial acumen with experience in managing programme budgets, forecasts, and revenue. Proven track record of building and maintaining executive relationships. Work Environment and Travel This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires regular travel across the Middle East, including Dubai and other customer locations. Occasional travel across UKI may also be required as needed. The position involves working within a dynamic environment, supporting Adobe's mission to empower businesses and individuals through creativity and digital transformation, particularly in alignment with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. About Adobe Adobe empowers individuals and businesses to create through innovative platforms and tools that foster creativity, productivity, and personalized customer experiences. With over 30,000 employees worldwide, Adobe drives growth by developing industry-leading offerings such as Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio. In the Middle East, Adobe supports regional digital transformation, talent development, and customer experiences, serving as a strategic hub for growth and collaboration.

9a08260585c539a4.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced Accommodation Outfitting Designer (CS) for full-time work on marine and shipbuilding projects. This role involves providing design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving outfitting issues, and ensuring design accuracy and compliance with project specifications and marine standards. Key Responsibilities Provide construction and production support for accommodation design and outfitting activities. Prepare, review, and revise accommodation design deliverables, including general arrangement drawings, cabin layouts, public area layouts, internal partition drawings, furniture arrangements, and interior outfitting details. Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams for fabrication, assembly, and installation. Resolve technical queries, drawing discrepancies, and production-related design issues. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with other engineering disciplines (Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Electrical & Instrumentation, HVAC, Piping) to ensure proper integration and avoid design clashes. Verify accommodation layouts, furniture arrangements, equipment locations, and space utilization against project specifications. Coordinate with HVAC and E&I teams for proper integration of services within accommodation spaces. Review vendor drawings, material specifications, and technical documentation for outfitting components. Ensure design deliverables comply with project specifications, marine standards, classification requirements, and safety regulations. Support constructability reviews and identify potential fabrication and installation issues. Maintain updated production drawings, design records, and technical documentation. Coordinate with engineering teams, vendors, and production personnel for timely resolution of design issues. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications. Ensure design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Interior Design, or an equivalent relevant discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in accommodation outfitting design within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in accommodation layouts, cabin arrangements, interior outfitting, furniture layouts, partitions, ceilings, flooring, and associated installation details. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other client-accepted shipbuilding CAD software. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, fabrication drawings, and installation drawings. Good understanding of marine accommodation design, space utilization, joinery, interior outfitting materials, and shipyard construction practices. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, shop drawings, technical specifications, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during accommodation outfitting and installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification requirements, applicable shipbuilding standards, accommodation safety requirements, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Electrical & Instrumentation, HVAC, and Piping disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, or FPSOs is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Required Skills Strong technical problem-solving skills. Proficiency in drawing interpretation. Effective coordination and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply.

This full-time role involves delivering a range of spa services while maintaining high standards of guest experience and operational hygiene. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Guest Service Officer is responsible for providing professional spa treatments and ensuring a comfortable, safe, and confidential environment for all guests. This role emphasizes adherence to established procedures and collaboration with colleagues to deliver a seamless service experience. Key Responsibilities Deliver various spa services, including body treatments, massages, facials, waxing, and aromatherapy, ensuring guest safety and comfort. Maintain a clean and hygienic treatment room in accordance with established standards and procedures. Uphold the highest standards of guest privacy and confidentiality at all times. Collaborate effectively with other spa professionals to ensure a seamless guest experience. Participate in staff meetings, training sessions, and product knowledge updates as required. Maintain a professional and courteous demeanor, providing exceptional customer service. Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and standards, including health and safety regulations. Strong understanding of hygiene and safety protocols within a spa environment. Required Skills Excellent customer service and interpersonal communication skills. 9a8543c2164ed830.description: About Orange Business Orange Business operates as a network and digital integrator, focusing on the entire value chain of the digital world. The company aims to enable its customers to concentrate on strategic business initiatives by providing consistent, sustainable global solutions. With over 30,000 employees across various continents, Orange Business offers a dynamic environment for professional development. Greet guests and record their requests. Store office supplies and arrange furniture and appliances within rooms. Dust, polish, and remove marks from walls and furniture. 9a3cc146114c6d54.description: Company Description Mokamela specializes in the manufacturing of prefabricated buildings, including labor accommodations, offices, guardhouses, canteens, and kitchens. Strong attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

9ae1d3bdbb0ca11e.description: Job Description: Quality Assurance Specialist Department: Quality Assurance / Operations Reports To: Quality Assurance Manager / Operations Director Employment Type: Full-Time Job Objective Establish, implement, and maintain Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks and standards across organizational operations. The Quality Assurance Specialist will be responsible for evaluating operational workflows, conducting compliance audits, identifying risks and process bottlenecks, and reviewing customer service interactions to ensure high-quality service delivery and continuous process improvement. Key Responsibilities QA Framework Implementation: Implement and maintain quality assurance policies, evaluation standards, and audit frameworks across operational units. Call & Interaction Quality Auditing: Monitor and evaluate customer service calls, chats, and ticketing interactions using QA scorecards to ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and established service standards. Process & Compliance Audits: Conduct regular internal audits of operational processes, document compliance gaps, and recommend corrective actions. Experience 2–5 years of experience in quality assurance, process auditing, or quality monitoring within a corporate or contact center environment. Preferred Professional Certifications Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor / Internal Auditor. Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt. Certified Quality Improvement Associate (CQIA) or Total Quality Management (TQM). Technical Skills Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Hands-on experience with QA software, CRM platforms, and call recording systems. Core Competencies Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail. Excellent problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities. A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational efficiency and service quality.

9a6bc5723a9fbc23.description: The Team We are an award winning global consultancy and have been named Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022 and 2021. We are at the forefront of the industry, priding ourselves on our exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable projects. Sustainability runs through everything we do at Cundall, and our people are empowered to drive change and decarbonise the built environment. By the end of this decade, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal to only work on projects that meet our zero carbon design criteria, a commitment we have called our Zero Carbon Design 2030 goal. We need engineers who share this passion for sustainability and thrive in designing energy efficient buildings and communities. Cundall’s Structural Engineering team prides itself in their exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable structural solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources. As one of the longest established of Cundall’s many disciplines, the Structural team are a source of world leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. The Role This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an experienced background in structural engineering to join our team at our office in Riyadh to work on the design of some of the most exciting structural design projects in KSA and regionally. As part of our established team of expert engineers and CAD technicians, and working closely with colleagues of various disciplines, you will prepare detailed structural calculations for multiple materials and using appropriate software. You will work across a variety of sectors such as Education, Commercial, Healthcare, Retail and Critical Systems, and will have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and as you work and are supported towards Chartership. The Skills Having already been accredited with a BEng degree level (or equivalent), you will have gained strong practical experience of structural engineering within a consultancy environment, and be proficient in the use of design and modelling software such as Etabs, Safe, SAP, Robot, Prokon, and IDEA StatiCa. Key Requirements Chartered or actively working towards getting chartered (MIStructE) Candidates with knowledge of ETABS, SAFE, SAP etc. Knowledge of parametric designing and associated programmes would be advantageous. A knowledge of the Building Codes [UAE/KSA] and international codes. 8 to 12 years post graduate experience within a similar role / consultancy environment. Experience in preparing structural calculations, design reports and presentations. Experience in monitoring the works of engineers and technicians and reviewing /verifying their work. Able to work independently and in a team of multidisciplinary professionals. Job Description Your career at Cundall We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.

9a0ac1739a441026.description: Our client is seeking a Senior Development Director to lead the front-end development of a substantial portfolio of villas, apartments and townhouses in Riyadh. The role sits within a major destination-led development and carries influence across product strategy, feasibility, design direction, commercial planning, and delivery readiness. This is a senior client-side development appointment for someone who has created and delivered residential product, rather than managed construction after the principal development decisions have already been taken. The role You will lead a portfolio of villas and townhouse developments through the early and middle stages of the development lifecycle. Your remit will include: Leading projects from initial feasibility through to delivery readiness Defining product strategy, unit mix, positioning, phasing, and development briefs Owning feasibility studies, financial modelling, business planning, and commercial optimisation Balancing market demand, product quality, design, cost, programme, and profitability Managing masterplanning, design development, consultants, approvals, and procurement strategy Testing and challenging assumptions across design, commercial, and delivery teams Representing the development function in senior stakeholder and investment discussions Building effective relationships with internal teams, external consultants, authorities, and delivery partners Improving development governance, decision-making, and processes across the portfolio Although the role retains accountability across the full development cycle, its principal focus is the front end, where product, investment, and development strategy are established. The person You will be an experienced client-side residential developer with a strong record of delivering villas, townhouses, housing communities, or comparable low-rise residential product. You should bring: Substantial residential development experience gained with a recognised developer, investor, or development organisation A clear record of leading multiple projects from feasibility and product definition through design and into delivery Strong financial appraisal, feasibility, and commercial decision-making capability Experience defining residential products, unit mixes, positioning, and development briefs The ability to balance design quality with commercial performance, programme, and delivery risk Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, consultants, and senior stakeholders The credibility to present recommendations, defend a business case, and challenge constructively Stable career tenure and evidence of increasing responsibility Middle East development experience is preferred, but not essential A recognised university degree is required, with real estate, finance, or commercial qualifications advantageous Candidates should be able to describe the residential projects they have led in specific terms, including unit numbers, product type, market positioning, project scale, development stages, and their personal accountability. This is not a pure project management, design management, construction delivery, operations, asset management, sales, or marketing role. Candidates whose experience is predominantly contractor, PMC, consultancy, or site delivery-led will not match the mandate. The opportunity The successful candidate will join a residential business responsible for creating new neighbourhoods within one of Saudi Arabia’s most significant destination-led developments. The villas and townhouses portfolio forms an important part of the wider residential strategy. This appointment will help determine what is developed, how the product is positioned, how the commercial case is structured, and how projects are prepared for successful delivery. The role offers long-term portfolio scale, direct access to senior decision-makers, and real influence over the development direction.

You will provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment between business needs and technology implementations. Responsibilities: Lead requirements gathering and analysis sessions with business stakeholders to identify needs and objectives. Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and design documents. Conduct impact analysis, gap analysis, and feasibility studies to inform decision-making. Collaborate with IT teams, project managers, and vendors to ensure successful delivery of IT solutions. Develop and maintain detailed documentation including process flows, use cases, and user stories. Facilitate communication between technical teams and business units to ensure shared understanding and resolve issues. Support testing activities by developing test plans and coordinating user acceptance testing. Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in business analysis methodologies. Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to recommend innovative improvements. Job Responsibilities Supervise and manage shift operations in the tissue manufacturing plant. Monitor tissue machine performance and ensure smooth, efficient production. Maintain production quality in accordance with established tissue quality standards. Monitor machine parameters, stock preparation, and tissue formation processes. Ensure optimal operation of tissue machines, Yankee dryers, shoe presses, and related systems. Identify production issues and coordinate corrective actions to minimize downtime. Ensure compliance with industrial safety procedures, including LOTO. Coordinate with production, maintenance, and quality control teams to achieve production targets. Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering, B.Sc. in Chemistry, or a Bachelor’s degree in Paper Technology (outside the MENA region). Experience with high-speed tissue machines operating at 1,800–2,000 MPM is preferred. Experience with Crescent Former Tissue Machines, stock preparation, and headbox formation geometry. Knowledge of shoe press technology, Yankee dryers, cogeneration, and dual hood systems. Good understanding of tissue quality standards, including softness, moisture, sheet strength, formation, and bulk. Strong knowledge of industrial safety standards, NEBOSH principles, and LOTO procedures. Experience with Valmet, Andritz, or Toscotec machines is preferred. Benefits Monthly Gross Salary: SAR 8,000–10,000 Family status Additional benefits as per company policy. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma
